comment: PBR description for hero_character_skin (C-13). The material is the character surface 009 can author; the rigged mesh and animation that exercise skinning are outside this contract.
surface: worn woven character-suit surface, intended for a skinned mesh

skinnedPath.why: a rigged mesh, skeleton and animation are outside the 009 material contract; spec 004 Q3/Q4 fixtures own the skinned path and no Q4 frame exists

metalness.why: woven suit fabric is a dielectric; no metal is modelled in this cell
